title.en: R 4 2022 RELIGIOUS COUNCIL AND KADIS COURTS NAMING OF MOSQUES RULES

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-77-R-4-2022-RELIGIOUS-COUNCIL-AND-KADIS-COURTS-NAMING-OF-MOSQUES-RULES.pdf》（6 页），本次切分 8 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Religious Council and Kadis Courts (Naming of Mosques) Rules.
His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may name any mosque in Brunei Darussalam.

heading.en: His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan to approve name of mosque

text.en: No person shall be allowed to give a name to any mosque except with the permission and approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.

heading.en: Name of kampong or mukim as name of mosque

text.en: Notwithstanding rule 3, any mosque which has not been given a name in accordance with these Rules may be known by the name of the kampong or mukim in which the mosque is built.

heading.en: Application to be made through Majlis

text.en: Any person or body of persons may by application through the Majlis (in these Rules referred to as the “Majlis”) submit a proposal to name a mosque.

When considering an application to name a mosque by the name of an individual, the Majlis shall satisfy itself that —

(a) the proposed name is that of a person professing the Islamic Religion; or

(b) he has bequeathed the land and the mosque in entirely; 6 Religious Council and Kadis Courts

(c) he has bequeathed the land and contributed more than half the value of the land and the mosque; and

(d) he is a person who has given meritorious service to Brunei Darussalam and has interest, affection and has served towards the development of the Islamic Religion.

When considering an application to name a mosque by a name other than the name of an individual, the Majlis shall investigate the objects and reasons submitted in the application and shall determine whether or not these are reasonable. Application to be submitted to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan
Every application to name a mosque for consideration, whether or not it is recommended, shall be submitted to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan.
